name: Grande Cuvée Brut
descriptor: A pale-gold cuvée from a single ridge above the Saanich Inlet — ceremonial, mineral, quietly confident.
tastingNote: Pale straw struck with faint green light. A long, fine bead carries notes of orchard blossom, beeswax, and wet chalk, resolving into a saline, almost oceanic finish. Years on the lees have given the wine a patient, architectural weight.
method: Méthode traditionnelle — second fermentation in bottle, hand-riddled, warm-disgorged without fining.
serving: 8–10°C, in a white wine glass. Open thirty minutes before serving.

bottle.alt: Invinity Grande Cuvée Brut Blanc de Blancs 2018 bottle on the shore at Sidney Spit.

name: Grande Cuvée Brut
style: Traditional-method Blanc de Blancs, current release
descriptor: The house cuvée in its youngest expression — bright, linear, already elegant.
tastingNote: Green apple, linden, and sea spray. The bead is tight and persistent; the mid-palate is unhurried. A quiet, upright wine built for a long table.
method: Méthode traditionnelle. Whole-cluster pressed, wild-yeast primary, minimal intervention.
serving: 8–10°C. A tulip glass preserves the aromatics.

name: Grande Cuvée Brut
descriptor: A structured, copper-gold rosé with the quiet weight of long lees-aging.
tastingNote: Wild strawberry, blood orange peel, pink peppercorn, and a saline, unhurried close.
method: Méthode traditionnelle. Brief skin contact before pressing.

bottle.alt: Invinity Grande Cuvée Brut Rosé 2020 bottle.

name: Ocean Aged Grande Cuvée Brut
style: Blanc de Blancs aged beneath the Pacific
descriptor: Inspired by the legendary shipwrecked champagne bottles preserved for decades by the sea. Three years on land, three years in the Salish Sea, retrieved by a local diver in September 2025.
tastingNote: Salt-weathered glass. The wine within is denser than its land-aged twin — iodine, oyster shell, a whisper of kelp, then the citrus-and-chalk core emerges slowly, as though remembered. Every bottle is marked uniquely by the ocean.
method: Méthode traditionnelle. Three years land-aging, then submerged in a custom sea-worthy cage built by a local boat builder, held at depth in the Salish Sea for three winters, hand-retrieved.

still.alt: Ocean-aged bottles being retrieved from the Salish Sea.

name: Ocean Aged Grande Cuvée Brut
descriptor: The sea-aged counterpart to our saignée rosé. Retrieved in September 2025; each bottle carries its own weather.
tastingNote: Beneath the sea-pressed glass: wild strawberry and iodine, kelp, and a spine of oyster shell. The red-fruit core arrives slowly, as if remembered.
method: Méthode traditionnelle. Three years land-aging, three winters submerged in the Salish Sea in a custom cage, hand-retrieved by a local diver.
